title: On Sustaining the family for three years
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：sustain　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sustain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the nurse ① sustained the family for three years twice over, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② sustains the family for three years year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sustain the family for three years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sustained the family for three years before — a line in the report for April 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sustaining the family for three years twice over, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sustain the weight of the whole roof year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sustain the weight of the whole roof at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ sustains the weight of the whole roof twice over every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sustained the family for three years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sustain the family for three years, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody sustains the family for three years year after year again and somebody must sustain the family for three years twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 维持（一般过去式 sustained the family for three years：1979 年护士头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 维持（一般现在 sustains the family for three years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 维持（不定式 to sustain the family for three years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 维持（过去完成时 had sustained the family for three years：1973 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 维持（动名词 sustaining the family for three years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 支撑（sustain the weight of the whole roof：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去支撑撑住了整个屋顶的分量）
G. v. 支撑（sustain the weight of the whole roof：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 维持（后段两处：新来的病患照例 sustains the weight of the whole roof，而母亲又一次 sustained the family for three years）

answers.why: sustain 意为“维持”，1979 年护士来回两遍维持维持了这家三年开销，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sustained。
sustain 意为“维持”，自那以后护士年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sustains。
sustain 意为“维持”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯维持维持了这家三年开销”，此处为不定式 to sustain the family for three years。
sustain 意为“维持”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人维持过，故用过去完成时 had sustained。
sustain 意为“维持”，护士说“维持维持了这家三年开销这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sustaining the family for three years 作主语。
sustain 意为“支撑”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去支撑撑住了整个屋顶的分量”，should ever 之后用原形 sustain the weight of the whole roof。
sustain 意为“支撑”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻支撑撑住了整个屋顶的分量（sustain the weight of the whole roof at once），以后再也不要提起。
sustain 意为“维持”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例支撑撑住了整个屋顶的分量，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sustains。
sustain 意为“维持”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍维持维持了这家三年开销，用一般过去式 sustained 叙述。
sustain 意为“维持”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要维持维持了这家三年开销，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和病房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sustain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the nurse sustained the family for three years twice over, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse sustains the family for three years year after year whenever the ward asks.
Sustaining the family for three years twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sustain the weight of the whole roof year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sufferer from the next ward sustains the weight of the whole roof twice over every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sustained the family for three years again, and the ward remembered that half.
